title: Macterm extension
description: extension.yaml: a Macterm extension as a whole. It has what Settings → Extensions shows, and who maintains the extension. The capabilities of the extension are next to it in its folder. For now, these are palettes, one YAML file for each palette, in palettes/ (assets/palette.schema.json).

name.description: The name of the extension on its card in Settings → Extensions.

description.description: One line on its card that says what the extension is for. Start it with a verb.

icon.description: An SF Symbol name for its card. The default is puzzlepiece.extension.

authors.description: The GitHub usernames of the people who maintain it. Optional for an extension that you write for yourself. Required for an extension in the Macterm repository.
